about: Every threshold the Flock and the record read, one file: `flock` holds the Flock's cells and `publish` the self-merge and probe cells publish.mjs reads. A threshold is chosen on the record's readings and never tuned live; each carries the n and the window it was read over, or says in terms that it was not read. No default flips under n = 5 runs / 20 tasks: a threshold read under that floor is an `experiment` with its `rollback` named.

probe.unread: publish-as-probe (#835): deploy, live verify and rollback after the self-merge; pre-registered reading per release: publishes per run, verify reds, rollbacks and deploy seconds against timeout_seconds

exam.basis: the engine's limits before #1448; the catch-up reads the same cells, so a caught-up run is examined as strictly as the run
exam.rollback: none: catch-up's former 120 / 1800 let a fact red on time in the run pass at publish (#1448)

pulls.basis: run-268: 15 conflict-marked pulls, 13 of them to builders whose task never touched the file. Since flock-baseline run-10 (2026-11-13, n=1 run: a builder never received a file its task needed, three give-backs over 22 min, a draft) the scope narrows only what a builder is told; every published change reaches every copy in both modes
pulls.unread: the conflict-marked pull notes each builder got in files outside its own task, the pull rows marked quiet, and run cost, over the 5 trial runs against runs 268–272 (operator review decision 2, 2026-09-29)

jev_step.unread: per-step Jev readings joined to the operator's smoke (state-probe runner spec §10)

jev_peer_rewrite.basis: weave census #1401: in 43 Flock runs (2026-09-26..30) no merge wrote a line neither side wrote; the one edit over a peer's line (run-277) ran two of the peer's words together, and the run went green
jev_peer_rewrite.unread: jev:peer-rewrite answers against the landed line, over 20 peer rewrites; the drafts it causes per run

scope.unread: scope:outside refusals and driver:amendment rows per run (#1322: a green run merged a corrupted file no task listed)

stall.window: the 7 Flock runs 247, 251–255 and radio-station run-1 (2026-09-26..28)
stall.basis: the longest wait for a rise in the green count was 2.0 min; run-252 ran 229.7 min after its last rise
stall.unread: stall:no-progress rows per run and the wall a stalled run no longer spends (#1334)

loose_ends.basis: #1419: 21 builder beliefs over n=15 runs (run-277..291), almost all loose ends; 10 of 21 reached no later session
loose_ends.unread: loose ends per run, the share resolved in the run, and the drafts or wall the L:loose task adds

main.basis: audit 2026-11-12: the weave lived for one run and the catch-up rebuilt it from three texts, so the queue was cut by file; over 65 Flock runs (2026-09-26..10-02) 54 of 783 written files had more than one builder. Probe (n=25 files, 917 commits): a stored weave reloads exactly, and two weaves of one text built by different routes never agree, so a tree's weave is stored once and shared
main.rollback: mode = frozen (every weave begun from the base's text; the catch-up joins three texts); deleting the target's ref refs/ultrapowers/weave/v1 forgets the memory
main.unread: weave:memory and weave:store rows per run (memory true, stored true), weave:push rows (pushed, forks), and catch-ups joined from the store against their conflicts, over the first 5 runs; whether the sandbox's credential may push the ref at all
